stations.title: Home page
stations.text: Says the times are on the classes page.

captions: Visitors keep asking Kofi when his Thursday wheel class is.
The times are on his new classes page, but nothing on the home page leads there.
You link the pages both ways, add jump links, and make email and phone links.
One click from the home page and the Thursday class is right there.
Same two pages. Now they work as one small site.
